title: On/Off  Sensor Electric Window Candle
text: On/Off  Sensor Electric Window Candle. Did not care for this candle because of the on off switch I use electric candles in my windows year around and they come on at dusk and off at dawn, so I am not using this candle and I ordered one like the other candles I use.

product_metadata.title: Creative Hobbies® Electric Window Candle Lamp with Brass Plated Base, On/Off Switch, Light Bulb, Ready to Use!
features: Creative Hobbies electric candles are the perfect addition to add a little something extra to your homes curb appeal. These are perfect as window candles, centerpieces, and other home and restaurant décor. They are also great for events like weddings, graduation parties, and birthdays!

These window candles measure 6.75” tall and 9” overall when you include the bulb in the measurement. They have a brass plated base and an extra long 5 foot cord with an on/off switch with all UL approved parts.

The candles will last years to come and we also carry the perfect replacement bulb which can be found by searching for “B00MTRAWIM” and window clips if you prefer to have your candles attach to the window “B09GHHQFXZ”.

Imagine the way your home will looks when the snows is falling on a chilly winter night and these candles are lighting up your windows. The candles are perfect inn your windows all year long, but they are great for the holiday season as well. They are great for Christmas decorations. Hanukah, Weddings, and Valentines Day.
These candle lamps are the ideal accent piece for any room. Simply plug in the candle, turn the rotary switch and enjoy the warm glow from the 7 watt bulb. Also available in 6 packs at “B08JNW9KWL”.
